title: Submatrices with the best-bounded inverses: the equality criterion for $\mathbb{R}^{n \times 2}$
summary: The long-standing hypothesis formulated by Goreinov, Tyrtyshnikov and Zamarashkin \cite{GTZ1997} has recently been solved positively by Sengupta and Pautov \cite{SP2026} in the case of two-column matrices. In this paper, we complement their elegant proof with the equality criterion.
